advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Set TMPDIR=basetemp for the sandboxed mutmut run in _diagnose_non_killed (ideally via a shared helper used by both sandboxed paths)
evidence: scripts/mutation_gate.py:660: # Survivor diagnosis executes mutated code and therefore uses the same sandbox.
scripts/mutation_gate.py:664: env = mutation_sandbox.sandbox_env(_command_env(root))  (no TMPDIR set before the sandboxed mutmut run at 665-674)
scripts/mutation_sandbox.py:246-252: sandbox_env only sets HOME and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, not TMPDIR
advisory.finding: _diagnose_non_killed runs mutated code under the same sandbox but does not set TMPDIR to the writable basetemp, so tempfile.gettempdir() in that child still falls back to the checkout (repo root) — the exact leak this change fixes in execute_shard.
scenarios: A shard with surviving mutants triggers _diagnose_non_killed; shard code calling tempfile APIs under the read-only-system-temp sandbox writes temp files into the repo root
advisory.suggested_fix: Factor a helper, e.g. `def _sandboxed_env(root, basetemp): env = mutation_sandbox.sandbox_env(_command_env(root)); env["TMPDIR"] = str(basetemp); return env`, and use it in both execute_shard and _diagnose_non_killed.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Let the clean run succeed in fake_run and also check TMPDIR on the mutmut-run child's env (seen[1]), or reword the docstring to cover only the clean run.
evidence: Docstring: "Both sandboxed children must see TMPDIR at the writable pytest base."
fake_run: `return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 1, "", "")` and the only env assertion is `assert seen[0].get("TMPDIR") == str(basetemp)`
scripts/mutation_gate.py:600-601: `if clean.returncode: raise GateError("baseline-test", ...)` runs before the mutmut run child at scripts/mutation_gate.py:602-611
advisory.finding: test_shard_children_get_a_writable_temp_dir's docstring says both sandboxed children must see TMPDIR, but fake_run makes every _run call return exit code 1. execute_shard therefore raises GateError right after the clean run, the mutmut-run child never starts, and only seen[0] is checked.
scenarios: A later refactor builds a separate env for the mutmut run child and drops TMPDIR. The mutants then write temp files into the checkout, and this test stays green.
advisory.suggested_fix: Make fake_run return returncode 0 on its first call and 1 on its second. Expect GateError from the mutation-tool step, then assert len(seen) >= 2 and that every entry in seen[:2] has TMPDIR == str(basetemp).

Ticket comment: "Fix (amended into this change, patch set 2): execute_shard sets TMPDIR to the writable pytest basetemp for both sandboxed children."

Union scope lists only src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py, eight named test files, tests/unit/test_sync_marker_tempdir.py, docs/concurrency.md, docs/bash-migration.md, .github/windows-sweep-deselect/hardcoded-tmp.args and .github/workflows/test.yml. scripts/mutation_gate.py and tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py are not listed.
advisory.finding: Patch set 2 also changes the mutation-gate harness: it sets TMPDIR for sandboxed shard children in scripts/mutation_gate.py and adds a regression test in tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py. Neither file appears in the ticket's Scope list or file_impact, so this is CI-harness work beyond the authorized union scope.
scenarios: A reviewer or the completion gate compares the diff against file_impact and finds two unlisted files that change mutation-gate sandbox behavior for every shard, not just the marker.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add both files to the ticket's file_impact with the reason "sandbox TMPDIR so gettempdir() marker does not land in the repo root", or move the mutation_gate TMPDIR change into a separate prerequisite change/ticket.
